en: Black‑and‑white view of a hillside residential district with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century villas and townhouses in ornate Central European styles. The foreground shows a road and multiple railway tracks with a gas streetlamp and low fencing. Behind them are gardens and orchards leading up to large, decorative houses on the slope. On the distant ridge a small tower or lookout structure stands against the sky. There is no visible caption or printed text on the image side.
